description: This file contains the code-behind logic for a multiple-choice question exam page in an online examination system. It manages loading questions from a database based on the course, handles user interactions like submitting answers, timing the exam, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Partial class controlling the MCQ Exam page, handling question loading, timing, submission, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the exam page, loads questions from the database, and sets up the timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the score based on selected answers, records it in the database, and navigates to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles countdown timer updates and actions when time expires.
